# High Roller Technologies Schedules Conference Call to Provide a Business Update and Discuss Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


November 10, 2026 8:30 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_61b0a9205345e4f9c40a4f850b7d050e/highroller/news/2026-11-10_High_Roller_Technologies_Schedules_Conference_175.pdf)


Las Vegas, Nevada, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[High Roller Technologies, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HvDZhGliDtlqDwxcLtPgzlKLdeqMoqoX4ByMdl-oGzsD4vhgb1-Ohx__2bWHafaEALSKQ1pIk0eyd4kXaB92Qf4Sbwlo8r6NT6s4K22sT5g=) (“High Roller” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ROLR), an online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced that the Company will host a conference call to provide a business update and discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 4:30 PM Eastern Time (ET).


To join the live conference call, please dial **877-407-6176** (U.S. and Canadian callers) or **+1 201-689-8451** (international callers outside of the U.S. and Canada) 10 to 15 minutes prior to the scheduled call time. Participants can also click this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=-dSRfpSazPRstpWbb0cMkT9wUmI8Q4hn7idFPPv_lHGe2S475DHef8XmV31irsyKKMmYCq87vwU1nunBjgRzCAlu8Tr9oEkj9Z9xSw9Mgc9fDW6cHXT7GEh44b52BkUuMTaO5jAL4P1fHyaUtyWC9kPE8Cksi7v_vYf4mVEqxjS8vp_worjj7byZP5S72vuCvB4C-RibIYcLUww6Pbg20g==) for instant telephone access to the event. The link will become active approximately 15 minutes prior to the start of the conference call. The conference ID# is 13763816 **.**


Participating on the call will be Seth Young, Chief Executive Officer of High Roller Technologies, and Adam Felman, Chief Financial Officer. Management will review the Company’s financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and discuss key corporate developments and strategic initiatives, including its recent prediction markets launch. Following the prepared remarks, management will host a Q&A session to address questions from participants.


**About High Roller Technologies, Inc.**


High Roller Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: ROLR) is a publicly traded online gaming and prediction markets company, known for its innovative casino brands[High Roller](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HvDZhGliDtlqDwxcLtPgzqpYV6OJhcqGFDwlN1Ua9b0mjN3vyeBA3Q7XUBRgaUgxiiJ8cG45SW2u8yI6KOZCyHLoZrLC7CCx-AyAjDTwDzxI0Dw9XJZTS3NmTZcWjR3hN9olYFaMHR553ZXFoaoNd87sxqHQECpYtLosuUxr1wNHLo9RlLXAaM3Bvnc4cPBgbKW_yUuwNfMVqoDXPwC7p9dx6T-gv2k6w0IpLYxdMuY=) and[Fruta](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=CvS16lmkcSG1hBOnkfeNT-NNEq3My3UMRjwMJ9LdyNQG2vJJ2FFhzCLwlbRPXNyDdmKd49Dq7RCgRcFdE-HQgxpRnyJcrDHwS4b5kkV3HFtThDBXW4mJABmSqGfWnpGCRd0x7HGuoOhoJPDip4Vyi0zEz6VoWy8mLhocbY1AphVUa0eK7hw8s7a-n3dNNJvac3S8hv5lv27_uJCWhzOhHnZOv75svpZsH-xCKq_LOtM=) , and its prediction markets brand,[ROLR](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=X8BNj2ux_jVVnnHrr7Ue2GebWz-YlwPyqCc3KRMlN5tYXPqS6taUcwJCIIWdFRUgFBmAEMbXWWyF9-js_O2HbqZTs4X-Cbqm004sMtlFN59_PL-WOY2mJlCfph2JD2X_jyxJ4uHu1wXFRgQxWp7G582I8z_-4PUl7NhQv89YChe2QEMCZQunHikbAgxm9j_nRlngFQXg9xX0VTqdM7V07j1T38OiyLTkxDfnFFt_J2g=) . The Company delivers cutting-edge real-money consumer facing products that are intuitive and user-friendly. With a diverse portfolio of over 6,000 premium online casino games from more than 90 leading game providers, High Roller Technologies offers an immersive and engaging gaming experience in the rapidly expanding multi-billion-dollar iGaming industry. As an award-winning operator, High Roller Technologies continues to redefine the future of market engagement through innovation, performance, and a commitment to excellence.
